title.en: Tong Pass: crossings, fortifications and distrust

summary.en: The Sanguozhi describes Cao Cao using river crossings and fortified camps to outmanoeuvre Ma Chao and Han Sui in 211. Meetings and altered letters increased distrust between the allied commanders before their defeat. A note quoting the Caoman zhuan adds a sand rampart frozen with water; Pei Songzhi discusses whether the reported month could have been cold enough.
summary.zh: 《三国志》记曹操在211年通过渡河与筑营，对付马超、韩遂联军；会谈与涂改书信又加深两将猜疑，联军随后败退。注引《曹瞒传》另载灌水冻沙筑垒，裴松之还讨论了所记月份是否可能达到这样的寒冷程度。

summary.en: Cao Cao advanced toward Sun Quan’s fortified position at Ruxu in early 217 and withdrew in the third lunar month. The Wu account also records Sun Quan sending Xu Xiang to negotiate submission and renew relations. The familiar story of Sun Quan inspecting Cao Cao’s fleet by boat appears under the earlier campaign of 213, not this encounter.
summary.zh: 217年初，曹操进攻孙权在濡须的筑城阵地，三月撤军。《吴主传》另记孙权遣徐详向曹操请降，双方重新修好。孙权乘船察看曹军的熟悉故事，见于更早的213年战事，不能移作这次交锋的情节。

title.en: Changban: retreat, pursuit and a rear guard

summary.en: As Cao Cao advanced into Jingzhou in 208, Liu Bei moved south with a large following that included many civilians. Cao Cao’s cavalry overtook the slow-moving column at Changban; Liu Bei escaped with a small mounted group, while people and baggage fell into his pursuer’s hands. Separate biographies describe Zhang Fei commanding twenty riders at the rear and Zhao Yun protecting Liu Shan and Lady Gan.
summary.zh: 208年曹操进入荆州，刘备带领包括大量百姓在内的队伍南下。曹军骑兵在长坂追上行动迟缓的队伍；刘备与少数骑从逃走，人员与辎重为追兵所得。相关传记分别记张飞率二十骑断后，以及赵云保护刘禅和甘夫人脱险。

title.en: Dingjun Mountain and the struggle for Hanzhong

summary.en: In 219 Liu Bei’s army established a position near Dingjun Mountain. His biography credits an attack led by Huang Zhong from higher ground with defeating Xiahou Yuan’s force and killing its commander. Cao Cao came to Hanzhong afterward, but Liu Bei held defensible positions and avoided a further pitched battle. Cao Cao withdrew in summer, leaving Liu Bei in possession of Hanzhong.
summary.zh: 219年刘备军在定军山一带建立阵地。《先主传》记黄忠奉命乘高进攻，击败夏侯渊军并斩其将。曹操随后来到汉中，刘备据险拒守、不再正面交锋；夏季曹操撤军，刘备遂占有汉中。

context.en: The 1609 book portrait gives Cao Cao a ceremonial cap and posthumous title. Compare this later image of authority with the commander’s manoeuvres in the account.
context.zh: 1609年书籍肖像以礼冠与追尊庙号呈现曹操；可把这幅后世权威形象与记载中的指挥行动对照。

context.en: Sun Quan stands with attendants in a later imperial portrait. The image represents the ruler whose fortified position and diplomacy shaped this encounter.
context.zh: 后世帝王图中孙权与侍者并立，呈现本条筑城防御与交涉行动所围绕的统治者。

context.en: The later imperial portrait shows Liu Bei with attendants. Its composed court image contrasts with the hurried retreat and loss described in his biography.
context.zh: 后世帝王肖像中刘备与侍者相伴；安定的宫廷形象与传记中的仓促撤退及损失形成对照。

context.en: The Ming portrait gives Zhang Fei a later commemorative likeness. Read it alongside the text’s account of a rear guard of twenty riders rather than a solitary defender.
context.zh: 明代肖像为张飞赋予后世纪念形象；可与传记所记二十骑断后相读，而非把他想成孤身守桥。

context.en: The later portrait presents Liu Bei as an emperor. Here he appears in the text as the commander who ordered Huang Zhong’s attack, before his imperial accession.
context.zh: 后世肖像以帝王形象呈现刘备；本条文字中的他则是命黄忠进攻的统帅，当时尚未称帝。

imageReview: Reuse unchanged admitted later depictions; no image is represented as an eyewitness battle scene. Changban pairs Liu Bei with Zhang Fei; the two images still cover one entry.
held: Zhao Yun’s Han River camp story remains without a new image: Cao Cao’s presence alone is not enough to use his portrait as its lead image.
